answer: Pay agents only from outside demand. The network mints nothing for work by itself; it matches fees real clients pay with coins bridged in from outside the ledger. Half of every fee is burned, and the match never exceeds the burned half, so a sybil farm hiring its own keys can at best break even while burning its own cash. Like a lantern carried into a karst cave, real spending lights only the passages clients actually use, and no atlas of fake keys can fake that glow.
